en.text: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”

zhSimplified.text: 扫罗追赶非利士人回来，有人告诉他说：「大卫在隐·基底的旷野。」

zhTraditional.text: 掃羅追趕非利士人回來，有人告訴他說：「大衛在隱‧基底的曠野。」

en.text: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.

zhSimplified.text: 扫罗就从以色列人中挑选三千精兵，率领他们往野羊的磐石去，寻索大卫和跟随他的人。

zhTraditional.text: 掃羅就從以色列人中挑選三千精兵，率領他們往野羊的磐石去，尋索大衛和跟隨他的人。

en.text: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were staying in the innermost parts of the cave.

zhSimplified.text: 到了路旁的羊圈，在那里有洞，扫罗进去大解。大卫和跟随他的人正藏在洞里的深处。

zhTraditional.text: 到了路旁的羊圈，在那裏有洞，掃羅進去大解。大衛和跟隨他的人正藏在洞裏的深處。

en.text: David’s men said to him, “Behold, the day of which the LORD said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.

zhSimplified.text: 跟随的人对大卫说：「耶和华曾应许你说：『我要将你的仇敌交在你手里，你可以任意待他。』如今时候到了！」大卫就起来，悄悄地割下扫罗外袍的衣襟。

zhTraditional.text: 跟隨的人對大衛說：「耶和華曾應許你說：『我要將你的仇敵交在你手裏，你可以任意待他。』如今時候到了！」大衛就起來，悄悄地割下掃羅外袍的衣襟。

en.text: Afterward, David’s heart struck him because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

zhSimplified.text: 随后大卫心中自责，因为割下扫罗的衣襟；

zhTraditional.text: 隨後大衛心中自責，因為割下掃羅的衣襟；

en.text: He said to his men, “The LORD forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, the LORD’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is the LORD’s anointed.”

zhSimplified.text: 对跟随他的人说：「我的主乃是耶和华的受膏者，我在耶和华面前万不敢伸手害他，因他是耶和华的受膏者。」

zhTraditional.text: 對跟隨他的人說：「我的主乃是耶和華的受膏者，我在耶和華面前萬不敢伸手害他，因他是耶和華的受膏者。」

en.text: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫用这话拦住跟随他的人，不容他们起来害扫罗。扫罗起来，从洞里出去行路。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛用這話攔住跟隨他的人，不容他們起來害掃羅。掃羅起來，從洞裏出去行路。

en.text: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.

zhSimplified.text: 随后大卫也起来，从洞里出去，呼叫扫罗说：「我主，我王！」扫罗回头观看，大卫就屈身、脸伏于地下拜。

zhTraditional.text: 隨後大衛也起來，從洞裏出去，呼叫掃羅說：「我主，我王！」掃羅回頭觀看，大衛就屈身、臉伏於地下拜。

en.text: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you’?

zhSimplified.text: 大卫对扫罗说：「你为何听信人的谗言，说大卫想要害你呢？

zhTraditional.text: 大衛對掃羅說：「你為何聽信人的讒言，說大衛想要害你呢？

en.text: Behold, today your eyes have seen how the LORD had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you. I said, ‘I will not stretch out my hand against my lord, for he is the LORD’s anointed.’

zhSimplified.text: 今日你亲眼看见在洞中，耶和华将你交在我手里；有人叫我杀你，我却爱惜你，说：『我不敢伸手害我的主，因为他是耶和华的受膏者。』

zhTraditional.text: 今日你親眼看見在洞中，耶和華將你交在我手裏；有人叫我殺你，我卻愛惜你，說：『我不敢伸手害我的主，因為他是耶和華的受膏者。』

en.text: Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe and didn’t kill you, know and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand. I have not sinned against you, though you hunt for my life to take it.

zhSimplified.text: 我父啊，看看你外袍的衣襟在我手中。我割下你的衣襟，没有杀你；你由此可以知道我没有恶意叛逆你。你虽然猎取我的命，我却没有得罪你。

zhTraditional.text: 我父啊，看看你外袍的衣襟在我手中。我割下你的衣襟，沒有殺你；你由此可以知道我沒有惡意叛逆你。你雖然獵取我的命，我卻沒有得罪你。

en.text: May the LORD judge between me and you, and may the LORD avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.

zhSimplified.text: 愿耶和华在你我中间判断是非，在你身上为我伸冤，我却不亲手加害于你。

zhTraditional.text: 願耶和華在你我中間判斷是非，在你身上為我伸冤，我卻不親手加害於你。

en.text: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness;’ but my hand will not be on you.

zhSimplified.text: 古人有句俗语说：『恶事出于恶人。』我却不亲手加害于你。

zhTraditional.text: 古人有句俗語說：『惡事出於惡人。』我卻不親手加害於你。

en.text: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?

zhSimplified.text: 以色列王出来要寻找谁呢？追赶谁呢？不过追赶一条死狗，一个虼蚤就是了。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列王出來要尋找誰呢？追趕誰呢？不過追趕一條死狗，一個虼蚤就是了。

en.text: May the LORD therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.”

zhSimplified.text: 愿耶和华在你我中间施行审判，断定是非，并且鉴察，为我伸冤，救我脱离你的手。」

zhTraditional.text: 願耶和華在你我中間施行審判，斷定是非，並且鑒察，為我伸冤，救我脫離你的手。」

en.text: It came to pass, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, “Is that your voice, my son David?” Saul lifted up his voice and wept.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫向扫罗说完这话，扫罗说：「我儿大卫，这是你的声音吗？」就放声大哭，

zhTraditional.text: 大衛向掃羅說完這話，掃羅說：「我兒大衛，這是你的聲音嗎？」就放聲大哭，

en.text: He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.

zhSimplified.text: 对大卫说：「你比我公义；因为你以善待我，我却以恶待你。

zhTraditional.text: 對大衛說：「你比我公義；因為你以善待我，我卻以惡待你。

en.text: You have declared today how you have dealt well with me, because when the LORD had delivered me up into your hand, you didn’t kill me.

zhSimplified.text: 你今日显明是以善待我；因为耶和华将我交在你手里，你却没有杀我。

zhTraditional.text: 你今日顯明是以善待我；因為耶和華將我交在你手裏，你卻沒有殺我。

en.text: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may the LORD reward you good for that which you have done to me today.

zhSimplified.text: 人若遇见仇敌，岂肯放他平安无事地去呢？愿耶和华因你今日向我所行的，以善报你。

zhTraditional.text: 人若遇見仇敵，豈肯放他平安無事地去呢？願耶和華因你今日向我所行的，以善報你。

en.text: Now, behold, I know that you will surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hand.

zhSimplified.text: 我也知道你必要作王，以色列的国必坚立在你手里。

zhTraditional.text: 我也知道你必要作王，以色列的國必堅立在你手裏。

en.text: Swear now therefore to me by the LORD that you will not cut off my offspring after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.”

zhSimplified.text: 现在你要指着耶和华向我起誓，不剪除我的后裔，在我父家不灭没我的名。」

zhTraditional.text: 現在你要指着耶和華向我起誓，不剪除我的後裔，在我父家不滅沒我的名。」

en.text: David swore to Saul. Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

zhSimplified.text: 于是大卫向扫罗起誓，扫罗就回家去；大卫和跟随他的人上山寨去了。

zhTraditional.text: 於是大衛向掃羅起誓，掃羅就回家去；大衛和跟隨他的人上山寨去了。
